name: @nimbus/desktop
description: Nimbus desktop shell. A thin Electron window around the local server and web client.
author: Nimbus

scripts.dist: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/stage-resources.mjs win && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
